'''Brian Terwilliger''' (Players Committee forum name '''Twigg''', also listed as Brian Twigg) is a core member of [[Team Albany]]. He played the [[2020 World Championship]] and was runner-up at the [[2014 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-world-championships/ 2020 World Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref>
